turns.text: Hello. I need, I need a flight to Mumbai. Today, if there is one.
I'm sorry you're going through this. I can help. First I need your booking code and last name, if you have a booking with us.
Yes. Uh. Farouk. The code is P P 6 S 1 Z.
Thank you, Mr. Farouk. I see Dubai to Mumbai SK510 on Thursday at 07:45, Economy. Do you want to change this booking?
Yes. I need to go today. Is there anything today?
There is SK512, Dubai to Mumbai, today at 21:00, with seats in Economy. Because your booking is more than 24 hours old, there is a $75 change fee on Economy, plus any fare difference.
Okay. The seventy five is fine. Please. I just need to get there.
Understood. Shall I move your booking from Thursday at 07:45 to today at 21:00 on SK512, with the $75 fee?
Done. Booking PP6S1Z is now SK512 Dubai to Mumbai, today at 21:00, with the $75 fee. Is there anything else?
My, my mother, she... sorry. Is there a way to... no, that's okay.
Take your time. I'm sorry about your loss. If there's anything else about this booking, I can also request a supervisor callback.
